newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 12.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.55 (-0.13)
The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) has said it would liquidate its petroleum assets if it could not generate adequate returns over the next three years, The Australian newspaper reported on Thursday.

The Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) rate cut on Wednesday is expected to further squeeze bank margins as competition has forced them to pass this cut on to their mortgage customers sooner than usual. The usual delay in passing on the cut to existing home mortgage customers dropped to about five and a half weeks from seven weeks. The CBA is seen most vulnerable to further erosion in home loan margins.

James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it has targetted earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) of A$20 million in the next three years from its Asian operations. It also said on Wednesday it was looking to purchase land in the northeast of the United States in order to build a fifth fibre cement plant.
